title: Gardner
html_source: In the middle of a thought about touching Mr. Bloom, Molly starts thinking of fondling (“to keep him from doing worse”) Lieutenant Stanley G. Gardner. It is not clear when this happened or if there was much more to the affair. It is also not clear if this happened before or after Molly married Mr. Bloom in 1888. I suspect this happened prior to marriage and probably just prior to when Molly and Mr. Bloom met.
